requirements.requirement: The system must include unit tests that validate correct years-in-practice calculation using a valid enumeration_date input.
The system must include unit tests that validate correct years-in-practice calculation using a valid graduation_year when enumeration_date is absent.
The system must include unit tests that validate fallback logic prioritizes enumeration_date over graduation_year when both are present.
The system must include unit tests that validate normalized_experience_score is computed within defined bounds for valid inputs.
The system must include unit tests that validate behavior when enumeration_date is missing and graduation_year is also missing.
The system must include unit tests that validate handling of future enumeration_date values by rejecting or correcting the calculation.
The system must include unit tests that validate handling of future graduation_year values by rejecting or correcting the calculation.
The system must include unit tests that validate handling of extreme past values (e.g., very old graduation_year) without causing overflow or invalid scores.
The system must include integration tests that verify the experience measure is present in the provider detail API response.

The system must include integration tests that verify all required fields (graduation_year, enumeration_date, derived_years_in_practice, normalized_experience_score) are correctly populated in the API response.
The system must include integration tests that validate API responses remain backward compatible when the experience measure is added.
The system must include tests that validate null or missing input fields do not cause runtime errors in the calculation logic.
The system must include tests that validate consistent results for the same input data across multiple executions.
The system must include tests that validate the experience measure is correctly serialized according to the defined schema contract.
The system must include tests that validate graceful handling of invalid data types (e.g., string instead of date) for enumeration_date and graduation_year.
